primary_risk: Regulatory Risks and Changes in Payment Systems
sector_survival_note: Mastercard's moat is likely to last due to its strong brand recognition and network effect, which has been sustained over the past 13 years.
thesis_summary: Mastercard's payment processing network and brand recognition ride the big trend of increasing digital payments.
thesis_breaks_if: Short-term price moves, news cycles, and 8-K noise do not structurally change the next decade.
sentiment_note: Accumulate slowly due to rich valuation.
ten_k_highlights: Mastercard has a strong brand recognition and network effect, which has been sustained over the past 13 years.
The company has a history of increasing revenue and gross margin, with a 5-year revenue growth rate of 73.6%.
Mastercard has a strong capital allocation track record, with a 5-year share count decrease of 8.7% and no dilution.
valuation_note: FCF yield 3.6%, PEG 1.6, EV/EBITDA 22, P/S 14 — priced ahead of fundamentals — accumulate slowly.
